```yaml
name: Bump Personal Server After Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout hushline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run linting
        run: make lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: make test

      - name: Run workflow security checks
        run: make workflow-security-checks

      - name: Bump personal server version
        id: bump
        run: |
          # Get the release tag
          RELEASE_TAG="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          
          # Extract version number (remove v prefix if present)
          VERSION=$(echo "$RELEASE_TAG" | sed 's/^v//')
          
          echo "VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
          # Update control file
          sed -i "s/Version: .*/Version: $VERSION/" hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control
          
          # Update docker-compose.yaml
          sed -i "s/image: scidsg\/hushline:.*/image: scidsg\/hushline:$VERSION/" hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          
          # Verify changes
          echo "Control file updated:"
          cat hushline-personal-server/DEBIAN/control
          echo "Docker compose file updated:"
          cat hushline-personal-server/var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump personal server to v${{ env.VERSION }}"
          title: "Bump personal server to v${{ env.VERSION }}"
          body: "Automated PR to bump personal server version to match hushline release v${{ env.VERSION }}\n\nThis PR was automatically created by the release workflow."
          branch: "bump-personal-server-v${{ env.VERSION }}"
          base: "main"
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Merge Pull Request
        if: success()
        run: |
          # Wait a bit for PR to be created
          sleep 10
          
          # Get PR number
          PR_NUMBER=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/scidsg/hushline-personal-server/pulls?state=open&head=dev:bump-personal-server-v${{ env.VERSION }}" \
            | jq -r '.[0].number')
          
          if [ "$PR_NUMBER" != "null" ]; then
            # Merge the PR
            curl -s -X PUT \
              -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}" \
              -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/scidsg/hushline-personal-server/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/merge" \
              -d '{"merge_method":"squash"}'
          fi
```
